dialogue.content: <image>这张 PPT 幻灯片展示了发动机参数的相关内容，请先帮我梳理一下图片里的文字有哪些关键术语？

图片清晰列出了几个关键的发动机参数，包括：
- BORE (气缸直径)
- STROKE (活塞行程)
- CAPACITY (排量/CAPACITY/cc)
- CLEARANCE VOLUME (余隙体积)
- COMPRESSION RATIO (压缩比)
- VALVE MECHANISM (气门机构)
- TIMING SYSTEM (配气正时系统)
这些条目都附带了具体的英文定义和单位说明。
很好，请把上面提到的所有参数按照‘参数名称、定义原文、单位、备注’整理成一个完整的 Markdown 表格，我要拿去写报告，请直接给成品。

# ENGINE PARAMETERS 参数整理表
| 参数名称 | 定义原文 | 单位 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|
| BORE | The diameter of the cylinder | mm | 红色字体标识 |
| STROKE | The distance between top most point of piston travel to the bottommost point of piston movement | mm | 底部拼写保留 bottommost |
| CAPACITY | Also called displacement. The volume displaced by all pistons while moving from top to bottom. Also indicated in Liters | cc | 提及也可用 Liters 表示 |
| CLEARANCE VOLUME | The volume available above piston, with the piston in top most point | / | 无独立单位 |
| COMPRESSION RATIO | The ratio between the total volume to the clearance volume | / | 比值概念 |
| VALVE MECHANISM | The mechanism by which the valves are operated. It could be push rod type or overhead camshaft type | / | 蓝色标注两种类型 |
| TIMING SYSTEM | The mechanism by which the camshaft & fuel injection pump are operated . It could be gear driven, chain driven or belt driven | / | 三种驱动方式并列 |
这就是您需要的完整表格数据。
